task: Placental materno-fetal transfer CERT: quantitative model of FOUR distinct syncytiotrophoblast transport modes (O2/CO2 flow-and-diffusion-limited with HbF left-shift + double-Bohr/double-Haldane; glucose GLUT1-facilitated-diffusion, downhill; amino acids active/secondary-active, uphill; IgG FcRn-mediated active transcytosis, uphill, isotype-selective). FALSIFIER: a single geometric theorem -- any passive (detailed-balance) flux law can only equilibrate a gradient to ratio<=1, so a measured ratio>1 is a decisive signature an active/receptor-mediated step is load-bearing -- correctly sorts real measured maternal:fetal ratios (O2/glucose downhill; amino-acids/IgG uphill, ratio>1) into the mechanism classes the literature independently assigns them. IgG-specificity adversary forced to its strongest fair form (Stokes-Einstein diffusion, zero free parameters, after an initial free-exponential adversary was rejected as unfairly weak).

PMC-full-text-verified (not abstract-only) for the two most load-bearing numbers: HbF/HbA P50 (Jackson 2026) and glucose vessel concentrations (Zamudio 2010). Illustrative/textbook tier, explicitly flagged and NOT independently NCBI-verified this session, for: total-amino-acid ratio magnitude (1.3), Na+/Vm constants, GLUT1 Km, FcRn endosomal pH, Ig molecular weights, shared Hill n=2.7 -- none load-bearing for the qualitative falsifier itself.
